newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ivernia hopeful of more Lisheen reserves.
newsitem.headline: Ivernia hopeful of more Lisheen reserves.

text.p: Irish exploration and mining company Ivernia West Plc announced its annual results on Thursday and said it was hopeful of finding further reserves at its Lisheen lead/zinc mine in Ireland.
Ivernia West is developing the mine at Lisheen in a joint venture with Minorco.
"The joint venture remains hopeful that additional reserves will be discovered in the Lisheen area," Ivernia West said in its results statement.
Total exploration and development expenditure in the year to March 31 was 2.96 million Irish pounds, Ivernia West said.
Administration and finance costs came to 1.37 million punts, giving total operating costs of 4.33 million punts, the company said.
